title: Moss Rainroom
description: The melody is heard in the left hand above a held bass, with quiet upper chords opening and closing around it. Its minor colour passes through D-flat and A-flat light, then a more active tenor line briefly fills the space. The final phrase withdraws into a plain F beneath a still-sounding upper ninth.
technical_note: The LH carries bass and tenor independently. Sustain its low note while allowing the tenor fingers to phrase freely; the combined stretch never exceeds an octave. The RH chords should remain behind the lower melody. Every held tone and shared-key occupation is checked across both lower voices.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and independent note lengths; no random timing offsets.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
